messages:
Ava (people-ops): Quick Q from a manager: can we do a 'spot promotion' (no band change) mid-cycle for impact recognition? What approvals are needed and how does payroll intake look?

latoya (manager): Example: want to bump someone +8% as a spot increase for leadership during runway crunch. No title change, stays same band. Need to know thresholds for compops review and whether payroll needs separate fields.

mike (engineering): Manager-side note: we want the bump to show in next paycheck and not wait for the formal leveling window. Prefer no equity or band change.

iris (compops): Short answer: spot increases <=10% and within band floor/ceiling generally go through manager+director approval and People Ops notification. Anything >10% or that pushes salary above band cap requires CompOps review and VP sign-off. Record the business rationale in the packet.

payroll-bot: Payroll bot: global ad-hoc payroll file cutoff for spot changes = 2026-09-05 23:59 UTC. Uploads to sftp://payroll-uploads/ad-hoc/. Validation reports posted to #payroll-ops within 24h.

sam (payroll): For payroll we expect a numeric `spot_amount` field (one-time or ongoing) and `action=set_salary` if the increase is permanent. If ongoing: include old_annual, new_annual, effective_date. If one-time lump, use action=one_time_adjust and amount. Example CSV below. Also include `packet_id` linking to compops/people-ops packet for audit.

latoya (manager): If I want the bump to be ongoing (new base) effective next pay, do I need both packet and payroll file?

iris (compops): Yessubmit the approval packet in the usual template (reason + impact + manager+dir signoff). After compops acknowledges, include the `packet_id` in the payroll CSV so payroll can match approvals. If you try to push payroll without packet, payroll will hold for audit and may delay the change.

Ava (people-ops): CSV example (paste-ready):

```
employee_id,first_name,last_name,action,old_annual,new_annual,effective_date,spot_amount,packet_id,notes
22111,Latoya,Ng, set_salary,92000,99360,2026-09-01,0,PKT-2026-457,"8% spot increase, manager+director approved"
22111,Latoya,Ng, one_time_adjust,92000,0,2026-09-01,736.00,PKT-2026-457,"prorated lump for remainder of month if requested"
```
Ava (people-ops): Guidance: compute prorated_amount yourself and include numeric cents. Payroll will not accept formulas. If you need payroll to compute, add `compute_proration:true` but that creates manual review and could miss cutoff.

sam (payroll): Tax note: ongoing base increases change taxable income immediately. One-time spot payments are taxed in the payout period at normal withholding. If you request a gross-up (e.g., to cover tax on a sign-on), include `gross_up:true` and attach CompOps approval; gross-ups require finance sign-off.

latoya (manager): Thanks. Edge case: manager wants to give repeat small spot increases quarterly without changing band. Any policy risk?

iris (compops): Repeated spot increases that effectively re-band someone should be handled via formal leveling to maintain transparency and band integrity. If you plan a sequence, engage CompOps early to consider a leveling packet.

Ava (people-ops): Final checklist for managers doing ad-hoc spot increases: 1) confirm manager+dir approval for <=10%, 2) create packet and get `packet_id`, 3) prepare CSV with numeric `new_annual` or `spot_amount`, 4) upload to SFTP before cutoff, 5) cc payroll for validation in thread. Ping People Ops if unsure. :white_check_mark:

latoya (manager): Great, will prepare packet and CSV. Thanks all. :rocket:
